entityExtensionTemplates.name: Standard Envelope Options
entityExtensionTemplates.description: Identifies which GBBC/IWA dMRV standard, extension set, and sovereign methodology a passport was issued under. Adopted title: 'Vre Parfe CO2 Passport'. This is metadata about the standard itself, not the emissions claim -- it is not currently emitted by Mission Control's buildCo2RegulatoryPassportPayload() and must be added.

entityExtensionTemplates.name: External Methodology Options
entityExtensionTemplates.description: Reference-only link to an external methodology (e.g. UNFCCC/CDM) used for baseline and additionality logic. The external methodology citation is distinct from the sovereign Vre Parfe methodology identity and must be explicitly declared in governed CO2_METHOD_SCOPE_GRANT evidence; runtimes must not silently default it. Verified live correction: governance topic 0.0.8479702 seq 76-77 explicitly declares AMS-I.D with ARTICLE_6_4_PRINCIPLES, and HCS topic 0.0.8585272 seq 374200-374208 carries that AMS-I.D citation in both passport and confirmation. documentVersion, documentRef, documentHash, purpose, and dependencyStatus make explicit that this reference does not grant UNFCCC issuance authority.
entityExtensionTemplates.dataExample: { "authority": "UNFCCC_CDM", "methodologyId": "AMS-I.D", "methodologyName": "Small-scale grid-connected renewable electricity", "documentVersion": null, "documentRef": null, "documentHash": null, "validationRefCodes": ["ARTICLE_6_4_PRINCIPLES"], "purpose": "METHODOLOGY_AND_ADDITIONALITY_REFERENCE_ONLY", "dependencyStatus": "REFERENCE_ONLY_NOT_ISSUANCE_AUTHORITY" }

entityExtensionTemplates.name: Continuous Verification Options (CO2's own governance surface)
entityExtensionTemplates.description: CO2 issuance is derived from issued REC evidence, not from raw telemetry directly: Telemetry -> REC issuance -> REC allocation -> CO2 methodology -> CO2 passport / HTS unit. Accordingly this template covers only what CO2 verifies about itself -- methodology/GEF governance currency, parent-REC validity, and allocation reconciliation -- plus a chain-wide replay status. It deliberately does NOT include sensorAuthorizationStatus, gatewayAuthorizationStatus, signatureVerificationStatus, physicsGateStatus, fraudGateStatus, sequenceIntegrityStatus, or duplicatePreventionStatus; those remain properties of the REC/telemetry evidence layer (VRE-PARFE-HydroRE), reached only by traversing parentRecEvidence, never duplicated at the CO2 level.

entityExtensionTemplates.name: Audit Assurance Options
entityExtensionTemplates.description: States the assurance model explicitly and gives an auditor the exact HCS coordinates needed to replay CO2's own governance record. governanceTopicId, methodScopeHcsSequence, mintEventsTopicId, and passportHcsSequence/confirmationHcsSequence are already recoverable from live fields -- verified against governance topic 0.0.8479702 seq 77 and mint-events topic 0.0.8585272 seq 374200/374205. Traversal from CO2 into REC uses the passport's existing parentRecEvidence array (finalHcsTopicId/finalHcsSequence per parent REC) and is deliberately not duplicated in controlEvidence. Traversal from REC down into raw telemetry is a property of the REC's own passport record (out of scope here) -- this template no longer carries a telemetryTopicId field, correcting an earlier draft that implied CO2 depends on telemetry directly.

entityExtensionTemplates.name: Issued Unit Options
entityExtensionTemplates.description: Describes the serialised unit that was minted, whose quantity is derived from allocating governed GEF scope across issued, minted parent REC evidence -- not from raw generation readings directly. quantityMgCO2e/quantityKgCO2e/tokenId/serial/htsTxId are emitted live (verified fresh run: 1000000000 mg = 1000.000000 kg, tokenId 0.0.8585274, serial 31371, htsTxId 0.0.8411690-1783339679-479003501). unit, lifecycleStatus, and retirementStatus are now part of the five-envelope payload model.

entityExtensionTemplates.name: Abbreviated Passport Transport Profile Options
entityExtensionTemplates.description: Defines the registry-layer, lossless scoped alias profile for rendering compact CO2e Passport records and reconstructing them back to canonical five-envelope form. This is a transport/view profile only: canonical terms remain the source of truth, unknown fields are preserved, no evidence values are defaulted, and direct CO2-level telemetry coordinates remain forbidden. The full machine-readable map is provided in DeploymentPackage/AbbreviationProfile.json.
